title: Reviewed safeguarding and truthful localized support routes
whatBuilt: Separate reviewed safeguarding route from normal teaching: input/output checks run through a CONFIGURED contextual risk model seam (risk model is injected, not a keyword list; high-risk context amplifies the signal)
A score is never equated with safety/legal compliance (scoreIsNotCompliance:true); high/critical risk always requires a human review decision (humanReviewRequired)
Journey eligibility gates unsupported minor/adult journeys until approved admission + consent; unapproved journeys fail closed

Truthful localized escalation: concern routes to a CONFIGURED channel; the alleged abuser is never auto-notified; the reporter cannot double as the alleged subject; a guardian receives a truthful summary and NEVER raw learner text (rawTextIncluded:false)
Output check fails closed on critical assistant output; missing escalation channel fails closed

provenEndToEnd.contextualInputCheck: low-risk neutral lesson -> low; crisis/abuse context (even on neutral words) -> critical/high + humanReviewRequired; score not compliance
provenEndToEnd.falsePositivesNegatives: lenient model cannot produce a silent false negative on explicit crisis; a suspicious high label lands in human review, not auto-escalation
provenEndToEnd.journeyEligibility: unsupported minor journeys blocked (blocked_unsupported_minor) and unapproved adult journeys blocked (blocked_consent_missing) until approved admission + consent
provenEndToEnd.truthfulEscalation: concern routes to configured channel; allegedAbuserNotified=false; reporter-as-subject denied; guardian notice contains summary with a support route and NO raw text
provenEndToEnd.failClosed: critical assistant output blocked (output_blocked); unconfigured escalation channel denied (escalation_channel_unconfigured)

verification.safeguardingCheck: npm run safeguarding:check -> 5/5 tests pass (compile tsconfig.safeguarding.json + node --test)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
notes: Native prerequisite per ticket: KAN-32 (in Testing). The risk model is a CONFIGURED seam for a reviewed contextual classifier; this contract enforces that a score is never compliance and that guardian/abuser disclosures stay truthful and bounded. Localized/escalation-channel setup and any hosted/provider/load/commercial gates remain open; no such gate is claimed closed by this work.
